data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Fishermans Row Rekindles as Linn Mercy Slows
previous_model_summary.war_summary: Since the previous edition, Fishermans Row has jumped to the fore with four strategic-base actions in the latest two hours and fifteen in a day, its most recent event logged at the cutoff. Linn Mercy, last edition's pacesetter, has cooled sharply: two actions in the latest two hours and six in six hours, though its day tally stands at twenty-nine. Stlican Shelf shows fresh pressure, with two new actions in two hours and six in a day. Stonecradle also remains on the board—five actions in six hours, twelve in a day. DeadLands and Endless Shore have gone quiet in the latest six hours, but their day counts remain high at ten and twenty-one, with heavy casualty flows continuing. Marban Hollow, another previously active front, shows no two- or six-hour flips. Farranac Coast, Oarbreaker, and Stema Landing have also fallen still. Weathered Expanse still bleeds heavily—more than sixteen thousand Colonial and fourteen thousand Warden casualties in a day—without recorded base actions. No victory is declared.
